messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: List of AromaUnitTotalCnBinaryFile
parts:
On Fri, Mar 9, 2012 at 11:40 AM, Gregory W <greg....@gmail.com> wrote:
> From trial and error I see I can simply use the function:
>
> AromaUnitTotalCnBinarySet()
>
> and pass it my list of files.

Yes, i.e.

files <- list(...);
ds <- AromaUnitTotalCnBinarySet(files);

(I think) you can also create an empty data set and append files
(either one by one or all at once), e.g.

ds <- AromaUnitTotalCnBinarySet();
for (ii in seq(along=files)) {
ds <- append(ds, files[[ii]]);
}

ds <- AromaUnitTotalCnBinarySet();
ds <- append(ds, files);

I'm curious though, why do you end up with a list of
AromaUnitTotalCnBinaryFile:s in the first place?

/Henrik
